title: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus
seo_title: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus at Fun Mountain
description: Paint & Play with Mrs. Claus is a kids' holiday painting class where young artists create a holiday-themed picture with step-by-step guidance from Mrs. Claus and enjoy a snack. It is designed for kids. It takes place Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 1:00 to 3:00 PM in the Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain.
venue: Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain
